results.name: r2
results.command:
uvx --from git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.10.0 kmctl review due --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
bad=[e for e in d["due"] if e["reasons"]!=["unverified"]]
print(len(d["notices"]),"notices;",len(bad),"other reasons")
sys.exit(1 if d["notices"] or bad else 0)'

results.name: r3
results.command:
python3 -c 'import yaml,pathlib,sys
def fm(p):
    t=pathlib.Path(p).read_text()
    return yaml.safe_load(t.split("---",2)[1]) if t.startswith("---") else None
bad=[str(p) for s in ["components","nodes","practices","proposals","architecture"] for p in pathlib.Path(".okf",s).glob("*.md") if p.name!="index.md" and not (fm(p) or {}).get("sources")]
print("\n".join(bad))
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)'

results.name: r4
results.command:
python3 -c 'import pathlib,re,sys
t=pathlib.Path(".okf/summary.md").read_text().split("---",2)[2]
n=len(t.split())
tpl=["in a few sentences","citing the architecture pages","never one bullet per decision","what the bundle does not cover yet"]
left=[x for x in tpl if x in t]
miss=[s for s in ["architecture","components","decisions","nodes","practices","proposals"] if not re.search(r"\]\(/?"+s+r"/[^)]+\.md",t)]
print(n,"words; template left:",left,"; sections unlinked:",miss)
sys.exit(1 if n>500 or left or miss else 0)'

results.name: r5
results.command:
python3 -c 'import pathlib,re,sys
t=pathlib.Path(".okf/manifesto.md").read_text().split("---",2)[2]
parts=dict((m.group(1),m.group(2).strip()) for m in re.finditer(r"^## (.+?)\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)",t,re.S|re.M))
empty=[k for k in ["What this is for","Invariants","Values"] if not parts.get(k)]
inv=[l for l in parts.get("Invariants","").splitlines() if l.startswith("- ")]
nostat=[l for l in inv if "planned" not in l and "enforced" not in l]
draft="draft" in parts.get("Values","").lower()
print("empty:",empty,"; invariants:",len(inv),"; without status:",nostat,"; values draft:",draft)
sys.exit(1 if empty or not inv or nostat or not draft else 0)'

results.name: r7
results.command:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD main) && git diff "$base" -- .okf/log.md > /tmp/okf-log.diff && git diff --name-only "$base" -- .okf | python3 -c 'import sys,re
d=open("/tmp/okf-log.diff").read().splitlines()
added="\n".join(l for l in d if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++"))
removed=[l for l in d if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---")]
ids=[p[5:-3] for p in sys.stdin.read().split() if p.endswith(".md") and p.split("/")[-1] not in ("index.md","log.md")]
miss=[i for i in ids if "`"+i+"`" not in added and "`"+i+".md`" not in added]
print("missing:",miss,"; removed log lines:",len(removed))
sys.exit(1 if miss or removed else 0)'

results.name: r8
results.command:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD main) && for f in $(git ls-tree --name-only "$base" .okf/decisions/ | grep -E "/0[0-9]{3}-" | grep -v -E "/000[1]-|/0014-"); do git show "$base:$f" > /tmp/adr.old; python3 -c 'import sys
old=open("/tmp/adr.old").read().split("---",2)[2]
new=open(sys.argv[1]).read().split("---",2)[2]
ok=new.startswith(old.rstrip("\n"))
print(sys.argv[1],"ok" if ok else "BODY CHANGED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' "$f" || exit 1; done
